# Loud Hire

> Loud Hire is an event production and equipment hire company based in Thornbury, near Bristol, UK. It supplies sound, lighting, staging, video and power for events across Bristol, the Cotswolds and the South West.

The company offers managed event production and dry hire. Equipment and package prices on the site are guides; availability and the final price are confirmed in a quote. The warehouse is at Hacket Lane, Thornbury, Bristol BS35 3TY. Call 0117 214 1470 or email info@loudhire.co.uk. Warehouse visits are by appointment, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.

## Services

- [Event production](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/event-production/): Planning and delivery of complete technical production.
- [Sound](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/event-production/sound/): PA systems, mixing and engineers.
- [Lighting](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/event-production/lighting/): Stage, architectural and event lighting.
- [Staging](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/event-production/staging/): Indoor stages, roofs and rigging.
- [Video](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/event-production/video/): LED walls, displays and projection.
- [Power](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/event-production/power/): Generators, distribution and cabling.

## Hire and enquiries

- [Dry hire](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/dry-hire/): Equipment-only rental, collection and delivery information.
- [Party PA packages](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/dry-hire/party-packages/): Bluetooth speaker packages for parties and weddings.
- [Equipment list](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/dry-hire/equipment/): Browse individual hire items and categories.
- [Build a quote](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/quote/): Choose a pre-built or bespoke package and request pricing.
- [Contact](https://www.loudhire.co.uk/contact/): Phone, email, location and enquiry form.
